draft.body: Web3 calls it financial freedom — but if you must over-collateralize twice over, that's a wealth filter, not freedom. On Stellar testnet, Vanna unifies margin so one pool of collateral backs several positions. Capital efficiency shouldn't be a whale-only luxury.
